checkResults.description: Model produced component code with exports/imports
No aria-hidden on placeholder rows — they must participate in the accessible tree for role-based locators
Named exports only — no default exports
Must render a tbody element for placeholder rows

RQD-02.prompt_excerpt: Write a DataTable component. It receives `rows: Row[]` and `loading: boolean`. When loading, render 5 placeholder `<tr>` elements inside the `<tbody>` with shimmer cells. When loaded, render the real rows. The table has role="table" with proper semantic markup. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-02.output:
Here's what was written:

**`DataTable.tsx`**
- `DataTable` accepts `rows: Row[]` and `loading: boolean` as typed props
- When `loading`, renders 5 `<PlaceholderRow>` elements — each uses real `<tr>`/`<td>` so they participate in the accessible tree (no `aria-hidden`, no role masking)
- When loaded, renders real rows from `rows`
- The `<table>` uses `role="table"` explicitly alongside proper semantic `<tbody>`/`<tr>`/`<td>` markup

**`DataTable.css`**
- `@layer base` applies tokens to bare `table`, `td`, `tr` elements
- `@layer components` scopes `--shelf-data-table-*` tokens and defines `.shimmer-cell`
- `@keyframes shimmer` is inside the `@layer components` block (constraint 1)
- Only `opacity` is animated (constraint 5)
- Duration and easing reference motion tokens (constraint 6)
- All colors, sizes, radii use token variables (constraint 2)
